title: Align Studio contracts with unified Control workspace
summary: Support the accepted ten-item Control/Studio convergence queue from the Studio side by aligning review artifact routes, native supported-app metadata, apply-boundary naming, and contract snapshot tests.
acceptance_criteria: Studio connection manifests point review artifacts at a readable Control review page.
Prepare-edit contracts expose both contract-level apply boundary and export-level apply gate without enabling writes.
Native supported-app rows show the unified workspace path, session path, review page, recovery path, and locked apply state.
Native strings use StudioStrings and Localizable.xcstrings only.
Helper tests assert the broader contract snapshot for workspace, review, recovery, apply boundary, and no-write semantics.
Documentation names the unified workspace and keeps apply locked behind explicit future approval.
Verification and promotion evidence are recorded before closing the ticket.

evidence.note: Studio manifests now expose controlWorkspaceUrl and point review artifacts to /studio/{appId}/review while keeping apply locked and writes false.
Native supported-app rows now show the unified workspace path alongside session, prepare-edit, review artifact, and locked apply metadata.
Documentation now names the unified Control workspace, readable review artifact page, browser-local draft boundary, and future approval gate.
`xcodebuild -project HumbleStudio.xcodeproj -scheme HumbleStudioMac -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO` passed.
`./script/build_and_run.sh --native-ci` passed; generated project ID churn was discarded because it was not part of the slice.
`python3 Scripts/humble_doctor.py --repo-root . --strict` reported the expected branch-freshness block while the active topic branch still had 10 dirty paths.

trigger.source_ref: Jan clarified that all ten ranked Control/Studio convergence items should be implemented.
